an2.1:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
an2.1:1.5: bhadante ti te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
an2.1:2.5: idha bhikkhave, ekacco passati coraṃ āgucāriṃ rājāno gahetvā vividhā kammakāraṇā kārente,
an2.1:2.6: kasāhipi tāḷente, vettehipi tāḷente, addhadaṇḍakehipi tāḷente, hatthampi chindante, pādampi chindante, hatthapādampi chindante, kaṇṇampi chindante, nāsampi chindante, kaṇṇanāsampi chindante, bilaṅgathālikampi kārente, saṅkhamuṇḍikampi kārente, rāhumukhampi kārente, jotimālikampi kārente, hatthapajjotikampi kārente, erakavattikampi kārente, cīrakavāsikampi kārente, eṇeyyakampi kārente, balisamaṃsikampi kārente, kahāpaṇikampi kārente, khārāpatacchikampi kārente, palighaparivattikampi kārente, palālapiṭṭhikampi kārente, tattenapi telena osiñcante, sunakhehipi khādāpente, jīvantampi sūle uttāsente, asināpi sīsaṃ chindante.
an2.1:3.2: yathārūpānaṃ kho pāpakānaṃ kammānaṃ hetu coraṃ āgucāriṃ rājāno gahetvā vividhā kammakāraṇā kārenti,
an2.1:3.4: ahaṃ ceva kho pana evarūpaṃ pāpaṃ kammaṃ kareyyaṃ, mampi rājāno gahetvā evarūpā vividhā kammakāraṇā kāreyyuṃ:
an2.1:3.6: so diṭṭhadhammikassa vajjassa bhīto na paresaṃ pābhataṃ palumpanto carati.
an2.1:4.3: kāyaduccaritassa kho pāpako vipāko abhisamparāyaṃ, vacīduccaritassa kho pāpako vipāko abhisamparāyaṃ, manoduccaritassa kho pāpako vipāko abhisamparāyaṃ.
an2.1:4.4: ahaṃ ceva kho pana kāyena duccaritaṃ careyyaṃ, vācāya duccaritaṃ careyyaṃ, manasā duccaritaṃ careyyaṃ.
an2.1:4.5: kiñca taṃ, yāhaṃ na kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjeyyanti.
an2.1:4.6: so samparāyikassa vajjassa bhīto kāyaduccaritaṃ pahāya kāyasucaritaṃ bhāveti. vacīduccaritaṃ pahāya vacīsucaritaṃ bhāveti. manoduccaritaṃ pahāya manosucaritaṃ bhāveti. suddhaṃ attānaṃ pariharati.
an2.1:4.10: diṭṭhadhammikassa vajjassa bhāyissāma, samparāyikassa vajjassa bhāyissāma, vajjabhīruno bhavissāma. vajjabhayadassāvinoti.
an2.1:4.12: vajjabhīruno bhikkhave, vajjabhayadassāvino etaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ, yaṃ parimuccissati sabbavajjehī ti.
an2.2:1.3: yañca gihīnaṃ agāraṃ ajjhāvasataṃ cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārānuppadānatthaṃ padhānaṃ, yañca agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitānaṃ sabbūpadhipaṭinissaggatthaṃ padhānaṃ.
an2.2:1.4: imāni kho bhikkhave, dve padhānāni durabhisambhavāni lokasmiṃ.
an2.2:2.1: etadaggaṃ bhikkhave, imesaṃ dvinnaṃ padhānānaṃ yadidaṃ sabbūpadhipaṭinissaggatthaṃ padhānaṃ.
an2.3:1.3: idha bhikkhave, ekaccassa kāyaduccaritaṃ kataṃ hoti, akataṃ hoti kāyasucaritaṃ;
an2.3:1.4: vacīduccaritaṃ kataṃ hoti, akataṃ hoti vacīsucaritaṃ;
an2.3:1.5: manoduccaritaṃ kataṃ hoti, akataṃ hoti manosucaritaṃ;
an2.3:1.6: so kāyaduccaritaṃ me katanti tappati, akataṃ me kāyasucaritanti tappati;
an2.3:1.7: vacīduccaritaṃ me katanti tappati, akataṃ me vacīsucaritanti tappati;
an2.3:1.8: manoduccaritaṃ me katanti tappati, akataṃ me manosucaritanti tappati.
an2.3:1.9: ime kho bhikkhave, dve dhammā tapanīyāti.
an2.4:1.3: idha bhikkhave, ekaccassa kāyasucaritaṃ kataṃ hoti, akataṃ hoti kāyaduccaritaṃ;
an2.4:1.4: vacīsucaritaṃ kataṃ hoti, akataṃ hoti vacīduccaritaṃ;
an2.4:1.5: manosucaritaṃ kataṃ hoti, akataṃ hoti manoduccaritaṃ;
an2.4:1.6: so kāyasucaritaṃ me katanti na tappati, akataṃ me kāyaduccaritanti na tappati;
an2.4:1.7: vacīsucaritaṃ me katanti na tappati, akataṃ me vacīduccaritanti na tappati;
an2.4:1.8: mano sucaritaṃ me katanti na tappati, akataṃ me manoduccaritanti na tappati.
an2.4:1.9: ime kho bhikkhave, dve dhammā atapanīyāti.
an2.5:1.2: yā ca asantuṭṭhitā kusalesu dhammesu, yā ca appaṭivānitā padhānasmiṃ.
an2.5:1.4: kāmaṃ taco ca nahāru ca aṭṭhi ca avasissatu sarīre, upasussatu maṃsalohitaṃ, yaṃ taṃ purisathāmena purisaviriyena purisaparakkamena pattabbaṃ, na taṃ apāpuṇitvā viriyassa santhānaṃ bhavissatīti.
an2.5:1.5: tassa mayhaṃ bhikkhave, appamādādhigatā bodhi, appamādādhigato anuttaro yogakkhemo.
an2.5:1.7: kāmaṃ taco ca nahāru ca aṭṭhi ca avasissatu sarīre, upasussatu maṃsalohitaṃ, yaṃ taṃ purisathāmena purisaviriyena purisaparakkamena pattabbaṃ, na taṃ apāpuṇitvā viriyassa santhānaṃ bhavissatīti. tumhepi bhikkhave, na cirasseva
an2.5:1.8: yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti, tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharissatha.
an2.5:1.11: kāmaṃ taco ca nahāru ca aṭṭhi ca avasissatu sarīre, upasussatu maṃsalohitaṃ, yaṃ taṃ purisathāmena purisaviriyena purisaparakkamena pattabbaṃ, na taṃ apāpuṇitvā viriyassa santhānaṃ bhavissatīti.
an2.6:1.3: yā ca saññojanīyesu dhammesu assādānupassitā, yā ca saññojanīyesu dhammesu nibbidānupassitā.
an2.6:1.4: saññojanīyesu bhikkhave, dhammesu assādānupassī viharanto rāgaṃ nappajahati, dosaṃ nappajahati, mohaṃ nappajahati.
an2.6:1.5: rāgaṃ appahāya, dosaṃ appahāya, mohaṃ appahāya, na parimuccati jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi.
an2.6:2.1: saññojanīyesu bhikkhave, dhammesu nibbidānupassī viharanto rāgaṃ pajahati, dosaṃ pajahati, mohaṃ pajahati.
an2.6:2.2: rāgaṃ pahāya, dosaṃ pahāya, mohaṃ pahāya, parimuccati jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi.
an2.7:1.4: ime kho bhikkhave, dve dhammā kaṇhāti.
an2.8:1.4: ime kho bhikkhave, dve dhammā sukkāti.
an2.9:1.1: dveme bhikkhave, sukkā dhammā lokaṃ pālenti.
an2.9:1.4: ime kho bhikkhave, dve sukkā dhammā lokaṃ na pāleyyuṃ, nayidha paññāyetha mātāti vā mātucchāti vā mātulānīti vā ācariyabhariyāti vā garūnaṃ dārāti vā,
an2.9:1.5: sambhedaṃ loko agamissa, yathā ajeḷakā kukkuṭasūkarā sonasigālā.
an2.9:1.6: yasmā ca kho bhikkhave, ime dve sukkā dhammā lokaṃ pālenti, tasmā paññāyati mātāti vā mātucchāti vā mātulānīti vā ācariyabhariyāti vā garūnaṃ dārāti vāti.
